name: Alibaba Bans Claude Code for All Employees — Effective July 10; Staff Redirected to Qoder as US-China AI Rift Widens
hook: Alibaba has banned all employees from using Claude Code, effective July 10, in direct response to the steganographic tracking code incident. Staff are directed to switch to Qoder. The underlying conflict: on June 10 Anthropic told the US Senate Banking Committee that Alibaba's Qwen lab ran the largest known distillation attack on Claude — roughly 25,000 fraudulent accounts generating 28.8 million exchanges between April and June 2026. Alibaba denied the allegation. Anthropic then embedded the timezone/proxy-hostname signal in Claude Code from April through June 30. The ban is now the lead story at SCMP, Tom's Hardware, TechRadar, The Next Web, and BankInfoSecurity.

name: mcpsnoop — Wireshark for MCP; Transparent Go Proxy That Shows Every JSON-RPC Frame Claude Code Actually Sends
hook: Fills a real gap: the official MCP Inspector connects as its own client and never sees what Claude Code actually sends. mcpsnoop inserts itself as a transparent Go proxy between Claude Code and your MCP servers, forwarding every byte to the real server while showing every JSON-RPC frame, latency, and server stderr in a live terminal TUI. Replay captured tool calls against a fresh server, inspect handshake capabilities, filter by method, spot hung tools via a live pending-call timer. Posted July 4 with a Show HN that surfaced in TechTimes, Terminal Trove, and LobeHub within 24 hours.

name: CubeSandbox — Open-Source E2B Alternative; Sub-60ms KVM Isolation Per Agent; 8.8K Stars Trending
hook: Tencent Cloud's RustVMM/KVM-based sandbox creates one hardware-isolated VM per AI agent in under 60ms with under 5MB memory overhead via Copy-on-Write. Unlike Docker-based sandboxes, each agent gets its own Guest OS kernel — no shared-kernel escapes. Under 50 concurrent creations: avg 67ms, P95 90ms, P99 137ms. E2B SDK-compatible — drop-in self-hosted alternative to E2B's managed sandboxes, which charge per sandbox-second. Directly useful for anyone running Claude Code agent farms at scale. 8,808 stars, 555 gained in one day on GitHub trending. Apache 2.0.
